rules.label: Rendered cards: drawn by the template (findCard/card_)
Rendered cards: parts in order: picture, tags, content, tile row last
Rendered cards: a picture only when real
Rendered cards: a tag row of pills, the name a tag
Rendered cards: every tag the one pill (size, ends, border)
Rendered cards: no title line outside the tags
Rendered cards: one row of tiles at the bottom
Rendered cards: every tile the one round icon size
Rendered cards: no button or link outside the tile row or a form
Rendered cards: no wider than the measure
Rendered cards: centred: card, text and tile row
Rendered cards: font sizes from --fs
Rendered cards: text colours from the palette
Rendered cards: corners from the radius tokens
Rendered cards: no inline style
Rendered cards: padding and gaps from the --s scale
Rendered cards with the same tag, tile and padding sizes as the rest
Rendered cards: every picture the one --pic-h height
Card kinds drawn in one shape everywhere
Card shapes across all kinds (ideal: 1 + owner exceptions)
